title: Open-BEATBox Hardware: mechanical and electronics design files
description:
Open-BEATBox (Open - BEhavioural and AuTonomous operant Box) is an open-source, modular, low-cost platform for autonomous home-cage operant conditioning and long-duration behavioural data acquisition in rodents.

This repository holds the hardware design files: CAD sources, 3D-printing and laser-cutting files, KiCad circuit boards and their manufacturing files.

Project website: https://open-beatbox.github.io/. Manual: https://open-beatbox.github.io/docs/manual/.
